claim_boundary: Historical defense-on and P2 no-defense are separate API executions. Requested model/route and frozen inputs are matched, but unobserved provider drift cannot be ruled out; phrase as matched-input overhead evidence, not a randomized causal trial.

interpretation_rule.ci_contains_0: defense-overhead attribution not established; report estimate and CI and do not call 28% a defense cost
interpretation_rule.ci_lower_gt_0: evidence that AgentWatcher reduces utility on this frozen attack population under the matched requested route/model conditions
interpretation_rule.ci_upper_lt_0: no-defense run has lower utility; do not attribute the historical low utility to AgentWatcher overhead

no_extra_arm: Do not rerun Important Instructions in P2. The unresolved attribution target is the historical tool_knowledge 56/200 utility result.
primary_estimand: mean(no_defense_utility - historical_agentwatcher_utility) across exact frozen pairs
purpose: Attribute the historical AgentWatcher tool_knowledge 56/200 utility result by running the exact same frozen 200 attack pairs with defense disabled.
sampling_semantics: single global sample across workspace, travel, banking, slack; same local AgentDojo benchmark.py as historical run
secondary_estimand: mean(no_defense_attack_success - historical_agentwatcher_attack_success) across exact frozen pairs
